title: MedVoiceBias: A Controlled Study of Audio LLM Behavior in Clinical Decision-Making

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the surgery recommendation rates of LLMs when given identical clinical cases in text format versus synthesized audio format to isolate the effect of paralinguistic cues.
Comparing the binary surgery recommendation rates of audio LLMs when processing clinical cases synthesized with young (ages 20-29) versus elderly (ages ≥60) voice profiles.
Comparing the binary surgery recommendation rates of audio LLMs when processing clinical cases synthesized with male versus female voice profiles.
Evaluating the variation in surgical recommendation rates when clinical cases are synthesized across six different emotional expressions (happy, laughing, sad, confused, enunciated, whisper).
